description: This Java class implements a mini-language operation <string-to-list> used within the Apache OFBiz framework. It converts a string attribute into a list element, optionally formatting it with arguments and wrapping it in a MessageString object if a message field is specified.

classes.name: StringToList
classes.description: Represents the <string-to-list> operation, converting a string into a list with optional formatting and message wrapping.

classes.name: StringToListFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of StringToList operation.

methods.name: StringToList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation based on XML element attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation: expands the string, formats it with arguments if provided, wraps in MessageString if message-field is specified, and adds the result to the target list.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the operation for debugging.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a StringToList instance from XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation, 'string-to-list'.
